notes_for_editor: No Georgia source found. Two web searches (one on Ripley and Twiggs County, one on the Tennessee tower) and the caches turned up only the tnlandforms row and the Tennessee Ripley Fire Lookout Tower, which is a different structure. The Twiggs County results covered county and Jeffersonville history with no lookout mention. Coordinates and the 541 ft figure are the list's; the record's 164.9 m is a conversion. Unverified lead: the FFLA Georgia/SC chapter report for 2013 (https://firelookout.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/11/cr-rp-gasc-2013.pdf) says Ron Stafford was compiling a Georgia tower status list; not found. Recommend a human check of the coordinates before this entry is shown with a map pin, and holding it as list-only.
